# Step 1 \- Image \- Google Whisk Prompt

Subject: A dynamic, textured explosion of (subject) ingredients frozen in time.

Composition: Extreme macro, high-speed commercial beverage photography. A seamless, edge-to-edge composition of rich coffee textures and liquid motion.

Key Elements: The sleek (subject) is positioned at the heart of the frame, tilted at a dynamic angle. Surrounding it are thick, swirling ribbons of (subject) liquids. Whole, dark-roasted Arabica coffee beans are suspended in mid-air, caught in the centrifugal force of the splash. Thousands of crystal-clear condensation beads cling to the cold bottle surface, while micro-droplets of coffee catch the light like liquid amber.

Environment: An infinite, sophisticated, monochrome deep mocha and gold studio void. No hard horizon lines, creating a sense of suspended animation in a premium space.

Lighting: Dramatic "rim lighting" and "gold-toned" backlighting. The light should catch the transparency of the liquid splashes, making the coffee glow with a warm, reddish-brown translucency. Highlights should glint off the bottle's curves and the glossy surface of the coffee beans, creating deep umber shadows and brilliant metallic gold highlights.

Style & Details: Hyper-realistic, cinematic color grading, incredible textural detail. 8K resolution, ultra-sharp focus on the bottle label and the central liquid collision, with a soft, elegant bokeh fall-off toward the outer splashes.

# Step 2 \- Video \- Google Flow Prompt

**Sequence:** Cinematic product assembly.

**Visuals:** Start with a clean, high-quality gradient background that transitions smoothly from deep roasted mocha at the edges to a warm, creamy golden-beige in the center. Smoothly, a dynamic, marbled vortex of the subject’s liquid swirls enthusiastically into the center of the frame from nothing. As the converging liquids marble together, the subject dissolves rapidly into view at the precise center of the vortex, its surface glistening with icy cold condensation. Simultaneously, whole, glossy roasted coffee beans and fine, atomized mist droplets of espresso float gently into the frame from the peripheral edges, settling into a balanced, suspended composition around the central subject.

**Lighting & Camera:** The lighting begins as soft, flat ambient studio light, but rapidly transitions into a dramatic, volumetric "golden hour" rim-lighting glow the instant the product locks into place. This light should catch the edges of the glass bottle and back-light the translucent liquid splashes and suspended coffee mist. The camera performs a very subtle, slow push-in throughout the sequence to emphasize the converging elements.

**Style:** High-end commercial beverage videography, 4K resolution, ultra-slow motion capture to emphasize the viscosity of the liquids, crisp focus on the subject label and central action.

# Step 3 \- Website \- Antigravity Prompt

**ACT AS:**

A world-class Creative Developer (Awwwards-level) specializing in Next.js, Motion, and web interactions.

**THE TASK:**

Build a high-end "Scrollytelling" landing page for a coffee brand called **“Tuku”**. The core mechanic is a scroll-linked animation that plays an image sequence as the user scrolls down.

**TECH STACK:**

* Framework: Next.js  
* Styling: Tailwind CSS  
* Animation: Motion (previously Framer Motion)  
* Rendering: HTML5 Canvas (for performance)

**VISUAL DIRECTION & COLOR:**

* **Seamless Blending:** The background of the website MUST match the background color of the image sequence exactly so the image edges are invisible.  
* **Typography:** Outfit from Google Fonts. Clean, tracking-tight, minimalist.

**IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:**

**1\. The "Sticky" Canvas:**

* Create a component called `SequenceScroll.tsx`.  
* It should have a container with `h-[400vh]` (4x viewport height) to allow for a long scroll duration.  
* Inside, place a `<canvas>` element that is `sticky`, `top-0`, `h-screen`, and `w-full`.  
* Centered perfectly.

**2\. The Scroll Logic:**

* Load a sequence of some images from `sequence/`. Naming convention: `ezgif-frame-[i].jpg`.  
* Use `useScroll` from Motion to map the user's scroll progress to the image frame index (001 to 240).  
* Draw the current frame to the canvas on every scroll tick.  
* Ensure smooth interpolation so it doesn't stutter.

**3\. Text Overlays (The Story):**

* Overlay text sections that fade in/out as the image sequence run.  
  * **0% Scroll:** “The title with subheading (Centered)”  
  * **30% Scroll:** “Some slogan“ (Left aligned)  
  * **60% Scroll:** “Some slogan” (Right aligned)  
  * **90% Scroll:** “CTA copywriting and interactive magnetic button” (Centered CTA)

**4\. Polish:**

* Add an awwwards winning website style preload for loading state while the images pre-load to prevent flickering.  
* Add the following landing page sections that to make it complete, also make sure those other landing page sections wrapped in \-mt-\[100vh\] relative z-10 div so it closing the hero section, first is about section that have text-reveal component that is split each character and the revealed based on user scrolls scrub, then bento cards with some images, stats with numbers that are using count-up that make the numbers change from 0 to the real number when in view, testimonial with autoplay awwwards fullscreen slider, cta section with animated background, and footer, all of those with Awwwards winning level of design and interactivity.  
* Also add a awwwards level navbar consist of logo and menu button on all screen, that when opened showing fullscreen navbar menu with big text on navigation links text that have reveal and hover effect and then also have social media and contacts links.  
* Use lenis for smoother scroll  
* Ensure the canvas scales correctly on mobile (cover fit).

**OUTPUT:**  
Generate the full code for `page.tsx`, `SequenceScroll.tsx`, `globals.css, and else`.  
Use nano banana to generate images and UI components if needed.
